headline: Bill placed to abolish RAB and form its replacement
summary: The Special Response Battalion (SRB) is proposed to replace the Rapid Action Battalion (RAB) to ensure a more professional and accountable elite force.
details: A bill was placed in the Jatiya Sangsad to abolish the Rapid Action Battalion (RAB) and establish a new elite force called the Special Response Battalion (SRB).
Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed stated that a modern, professional, and accountable unit is necessary to suppress organised crime and maintain law and order.
Under the proposed law, all manpower, assets, funds, and records of RAB will be transferred to the SRB, which will function as a specialised unit under the police force.
The SRB will be empowered to investigate criminal offences, conduct searches, arrests, and seizures, and will include a multi-stakeholder grievance redress committee to handle complaints.

Opposition Chief Whip Nahid Islam and Opposition Leader Shafiqur Rahman supported the abolition of RAB, calling it a symbol of fascism, but demanded detailed parliamentary discussion before forming the new force.
The bill has been sent to the Parliamentary Standing Committee on the Ministry of Home Affairs for scrutiny, with a report expected within four working days.
Additionally, the Armed Police Battalion (APBn) Bill 2026 was also introduced, granting the APBn authority to investigate criminal offences and setting rules of discipline for its members.

headline: Tk 276 crore embezzlement: ACC approves case against Sheikh Hasina, Rehana
summary: The Anti-Corruption Commission has launched a case involving the alleged misappropriation of CSR funds meant for the Bangabandhu Memorial Trust.
details: The Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) has approved a case against ousted prime minister Sheikh Hasina and her sister Sheikh Rehana over the alleged embezzlement of Tk 276.30 crore.
The funds were reportedly corporate social responsibility (CSR) contributions collected from various banks, intended for the Bangabandhu Memorial Trust.
ACC Secretary Saidur Rahman Khan confirmed the development during a press briefing held at the commission's headquarters.
Former Exim Bank chairman Mohammad Nazrul Islam Mazumder has also been named as the third accused in the case.
caption:
Tk 276.30 crore in CSR funds allegedly embezzled. The ACC has now approved a case against Sheikh Hasina and Sheikh Rehana.

ACC Secretary Saidur Rahman Khan confirmed the development during a press briefing held at the commission's headquarters.

Former Exim Bank chairman Mohammad Nazrul Islam Mazumder has also been named as the third accused in the case.
